# Bouyon Musique
> The French and English guide to bouyon, the music born in Dominica: history, artists, riddims, styles and playlists.

Bouyon Musique (bouyonmusique.com) is published by Bouyon Shattaz. Artist profiles carry verified credits, release dates and a list of the sources opened for each page.

## How to cite
- Cite the specific page URL you used, and name the site as "Bouyon Musique (bouyonmusique.com)".
- Quotes are welcome with a link to the source page.

## Key pages
- [Bouyon Musique, home (FR)](https://bouyonmusique.com/): the guide in French
- [Bouyon Music, home (EN)](https://bouyonmusique.com/en/): the guide in English
- [What is bouyon?](https://bouyonmusique.com/en/what-is-bouyon.html): a simple definition of the genre
- [Histoire du bouyon](https://bouyonmusique.com/histoire.html): from Dominica in 1988 to the Antilles
- [Artistes bouyon](https://bouyonmusique.com/artistes.html): the full artist index
- [Artistes de Dominique](https://bouyonmusique.com/artistes-dominique.html): founders and the new wave
- [Bouyon soca](https://bouyonmusique.com/bouyon-soca.html): the bouyon and soca fusion explained
- [Wrecketeng](https://bouyonmusique.com/wrecketeng.html): the sampled root of modern Dominican bouyon
- [Glossaire du bouyon](https://bouyonmusique.com/glossaire-du-bouyon.html): riddim, jing ping, lapo kabwit and more
- [Playlist bouyon](https://bouyonmusique.com/playlist-bouyon.html): Road Mix, new releases and classics
- [Smokiller](https://bouyonmusique.com/en/smokiller.html): the producer who flips hits into bouyon
- [World Creole Music Festival](https://bouyonmusique.com/wcmf-festival-creole.html): Roseau, October 2026
